summary: 10 TCs reviewed; 0 real defects. Endpoint defined on router with NO auth dep (line 244 — handler signature has no get_current_user); identity comes from Redis state token. ?error= short-circuits to redirect (lines 275-278). Missing code OR state → redirect missing_code_or_state (lines 279-283). consume_oauth_state returns None when state absent → redirect invalid_state (lines 285-290). recorded_slug != slug → slug_mismatch redirect (lines 291-296). Provider type cross-check via isinstance OAuthIntegrationProvider (lines 298-303). exchange_code wrapped; IntegrationError → redirect with exc.code (lines 305-329). fetch_profile wrapped in try/except — failure logs warning and proceeds with profile={} (lines 312-316). Generic Exception caught with redirect callback_crashed (lines 330-335). Happy path: upsert + redirect ?connected= (lines 317-339).

defects.description: Documented exemption — confirm via per-route inspection.
defects.actual: Handler signature line 245-251 has no get_current_user dep; correct (intentional)

notes: SECURITY VERIFIED: state token mediates user identity; consume_oauth_state must use Redis GETDEL semantics (atomic read+delete) to prevent replay. Verified by reading consume_oauth_state — uses GETDEL pattern.
Slug cross-check (line 292) prevents an attacker from binding state issued for slug A to a callback for slug B.
